name: storefront-tour
description: Ten hand-authored natural-language questions over the bundled storefront package, written to vary grain, join depth, filter shape and answerability. Three ask for a concept the model does not define, one is deliberately ambiguous, and one has a silent wrong answer a careless grouping produces -- Every case is `dev`: the set is a walkthrough meant to be run whole, so nothing is withheld from diagnosis. There is no holdout, which means it cannot defend an acceptance check on a model edit without being re-split first. So a run has a score, a coverage gap, a construction error and an eval failure to tell apart.
sourceNote: Authored directly as a markdown numbered list in as-received/questions.md; one case per list item, question text copied byte for byte. No goldens arrived with them: every key here is derived by the conductor, first as DuckDB SQL over the raw parquet and then as Malloy through the truth package, and promoted only where the two agree.
auditNote: verify_goldens.py reports that dimension:customers:signup_date and products.retail_price do not appear in the model TEXT. Both are real and both are retrievable: they are columns the source exposes implicitly from the parquet, which a grep over the .malloy cannot see. check_findable.py returns 22 of 22 required entities retrievable by a search of their own kind. Do not 'fix' those ids.
